function.arguments: {"observation": "The reviewer correctly pointed out that the conversion from µg/L to ng/mL was incorrectly implemented as division by 10, when it should be multiplication by 1000 (since 1 µg/L = 1000 ng/mL). The data dictionary states that batch B reports in µg/L, not ng/mL, so values must be multiplied by 1000 to convert to ng/mL.", "implication": "The prior analysis incorrectly converted batch B values by dividing by 10, which underestimates the true magnitude of the biomarker values by a factor of 100. This leads to a systematic underestimation of the change in biomarker levels. The correction must be applied: multiply batch B `biomarker_final` values by 1000, not divide by 10."}
function.name: note_finding
